author: Rory Robinson
title: Minnesota wrestling match interrupted by furious crowd shouting foul-mouthed ICE chant - NewsBreak
text:
By Rory Robinson ,
1 hours ago
All Elite Wrestling's in-ring chaos on Wednesday night fueled a furious crowd in Minnesota that completely hijacked the atmosphere during a brutal main event between Darby Allin and Rush with loud chants aimed directly in opposition to U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE).
The AEW crowd at the Roy Wilkins Auditorium erupted in excitement during one of the most intense moments of the match. RUSH dragged Allin toward the apron, and the two began trading slaps back and forth in close quarters. The 5,000-seat venue is located approximately a seven-minute drive from where ICE agents fatally shot Renée Good .
As tension built, the crowd erupted in 'F---ICE' chants, drowning out the action in the ring throughout the chaotic No Countout match. Both Allin and RUSH are looking for their first opportunity to become world champion. Meanwhile, the White House slammed a crazy new theory claiming Trump faked his assassination attempt .
RUSH took control early by launching Allin with a belly-to-back suplex from the apron onto the floor, then tossing him into the barricade with enough force to send him flipping over the steel steps.
At one point, he stood on those same steps, taunting the crowd as Allin struggled to recover, blood beginning to show as the wrestling match wore on.
Allin came flying back into the match with reckless offense, including a missile dropkick that knocked RUSH out of a seated position on a chair at ringside. He stole the win with a step-through roll-up, but the finish was almost secondary to everything happening around it.
The chants have already become a defining soundbite and continued a trend that has followed AEW shows earlier in the year . The phrase has popped up at multiple events due to outspoken views from wrestlers like Brody King and has increasingly become part of the crowd culture at certain shows.
As Allin tried to celebrate his victory, Mark Davis stormed out and planted him with a thunderous piledriver on the stage before The Don Callis Family swarmed him in the ring. Lance Archer added to the destruction with a chokeslam, leaving Allin laid out as the show went off the air.
Chants against ICE broke out during AEW's main event The Minnesota crowd captured King on video in the ring after the end of the show went off the air. As they continued to chant, he shook his head in unison with the chants from the venue.
King previously wore a shirt that read "Abolish ICE" in capital letters during an episode of AEW Dynamite in February. Elsewhere on the card, Kenny Omega secured a No. 1 contender spot for the AEW World Championship with a win over Swerve Strickland.
Thekla retained the AEW Women's World Championship in a hard-fought contest against Mina Shirakawa and AEW World Champion MJF was announced to face Omega at AEW Dynasty in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, on April 12.

RUSH took control early by launching Allin with a belly-to-back suplex from the apron onto the floor, then tossing him into the barricade with enough force to send him flipping over the steel steps.
